name: EL.En. S.p.A.
summary: EL.En. S.p.A. engages in the production, research and development, distribution, and sale of laser systems in Italy, Rest of Europe, and internationally. The company offers laser systems for the medical sector and the industrial sector. It also develops, manufactures, and markets products, including solid-state laser, semiconductor laser, active fiber laser, dye lasers, and CO2 laser, as well as radio frequency, microwaves, frequency conversion systems, and high-intensity electromagnetic fields.
